purpose: Preserve 200 supplied proposals; never use as the installed capability manifest.
source_flag_caveat: Missing H/R marks do not prove hardware-free or easy implementation.

features.title: Component-aware wiring generator
features.description_from_supplied_note: Select the actual drives, switches, spindle, and controller modules; generate terminal-to-terminal diagrams and flag incompatible electrical interfaces before wiring.

features.title: Press-to-identify inputs
features.description_from_supplied_note: Enter commissioning mode, activate a switch, and assign the detected input visually. Identify inverted logic, stuck inputs, and multiple switches changing together.

features.title: Motor-driver setup translator
features.description_from_supplied_note: Convert screw lead, gearing, microstepping, and driver timing requirements into controller settings, with a physical measurement step to verify the result.

features.title: Controlled first-motion wizard
features.description_from_supplied_note: Commission one joint at a time using bounded moves, direction confirmation, scale checks, and verified limits instead of immediately enabling full-speed jogging.

features.title: VFD commissioning assistant
features.description_from_supplied_note: Provide model-specific connection and parameter instructions, then verify commanded versus actual spindle behavior using supported feedback.

features.title: Independent gantry squaring
features.description_from_supplied_note: Home dual-drive gantries independently, measure repeatability, and warn when the two sides require an unusually large correction.

features.title: Visual kinematics configuration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Configure supported Cartesian, CoreXY, dual-gantry, and rotary arrangements through diagrams, while explicitly rejecting unsupported combinations rather than silently accepting them.

features.title: Graphical machine-sequence builder
features.description_from_supplied_note: Build operational sequences such as “clamp, confirm pressure, start spindle” with timeouts, simulated inputs, and an explanation of why a sequence cannot advance.

features.title: Built-in signal oscilloscope
features.description_from_supplied_note: Display timestamped step commands, encoder feedback, probe transitions, drive alarms, and machine-state changes on one synchronized timeline.

features.title: Existing-configuration importer
features.description_from_supplied_note: Import supported settings from Grbl, Klipper, or LinuxCNC configurations, explain the mapping, and flag anything that cannot be translated reliably.

features.title: Guided stock probing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Find edges, corners, bore centers, and bosses using illustrated routines that preview the intended probe movements before execution.

features.title: Crooked-stock registration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure reference features and calculate the stock’s translation and rotation, allowing an awkward blank to remain where it is clamped.

features.title: Surface-following machining
features.description_from_supplied_note: Probe a warped board, PCB, or sheet and compensate engraving depth against its measured surface instead of assuming everything is perfectly flat.

features.title: Tool measurement with confidence checks
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure tool length, repeat the measurement when inconsistent, and flag contamination or an implausible change rather than blindly accepting it.

features.title: Two-sided machining registration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Guide the flip operation using pins or probed references, calculate the second-side transform, and show whether the two setups agree.

features.title: Rotary-axis calibration wizard
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure the rotary centerline, angular zero, and alignment relative to the linear axes instead of requiring manual coordinate calculations.

features.title: Leadscrew-error mapping
features.description_from_supplied_note: Import or measure positioning errors along an axis and generate a calibrated compensation map with a visible valid range.

features.title: Backlash characterization
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure reversal error at several positions, distinguish repeatable backlash from inconsistent motion, and explain when mechanical repair is needed instead of compensation.

features.title: Thermal-drift compensation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use temperature and reference measurements to apply bounded corrections from a validated machine model, with compensation disabled outside the calibrated conditions.

features.title: Inspect-and-correct finishing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure a feature after a machining pass and propose a bounded wear-offset adjustment or finishing pass, with operator approval before recutting.

features.title: Whole-job preflight
features.description_from_supplied_note: Check units, work offsets, required tools, travel, spindle limits, and machine configuration against the actual program before allowing execution.

features.title: Execution-matched simulation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Preview supported programs through the same interpreter semantics used for machining, including offsets, canned cycles, and declared macro behavior—not just straight-line backplotting.

features.title: Fixture-aware collision checking
features.description_from_supplied_note: Include clamps, toolholders, spindle bodies, fixtures, and machine limits in the check, and clearly mark unmodeled or unverified regions.

features.title: Remaining-stock tracking
features.description_from_supplied_note: Estimate what material remains after each operation so subsequent previews can distinguish cutting stock from moving through already-cleared space.

features.title: “Why is it moving there?” coordinate explanation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Click any destination and see how machine coordinates, work offsets, tool length, rotation, and active modes produced it.

features.title: Conversational machining with previews
features.description_from_supplied_note: Generate pockets, bolt circles, facing, slots, and turning operations from dimensions, while showing the resulting toolpath and required tools.

features.title: CAD-feature-to-operation assistant
features.description_from_supplied_note: Recognize supported holes, pockets, and faces; suggest machining operations and setups for review instead of treating imported CAD as merely a picture.

features.title: Remnant-aware nesting
features.description_from_supplied_note: Arrange parts inside a saved scrap outline, avoiding marked holes, clamps, damaged regions, and unusable edges rather than assuming a rectangular sheet.

features.title: Automatic setup invalidation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Moving a clamp, changing a toolholder, replacing stock, or editing offsets invalidates the affected collision and setup checks automatically.

features.title: Machine-specific completion estimates
features.description_from_supplied_note: Estimate time using actual acceleration limits, spindle ramp-up, probing, tool changes, and programmed waits, then refine estimates from recorded jobs.

features.title: Truly local job execution
features.description_from_supplied_note: Validate and store the complete job on the controller before running, so an interface disconnect does not become a missing-G-code problem.

features.title: Reconnection without duplicate commands
features.description_from_supplied_note: Restore the live controller state after a network interruption, reject stale requests, and prevent two interfaces from simultaneously owning motion control.

features.title: Guided restart from a selected operation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Reconstruct modal state, verify the tool and work registration, and preview a suitable entry path before resuming—not merely jump to a line number.

features.title: Power-loss recovery assessment
features.description_from_supplied_note: Preserve checkpoints and determine what must be rehomed, remeasured, or inspected before restarting. Never equate a saved position with verified physical position.

features.title: Broken-tool recovery workflow
features.description_from_supplied_note: Guide replacement, tool measurement, inspection, and re-entry into the unfinished operation without requiring the operator to manually edit the entire program.

features.title: Process-aware park and return
features.description_from_supplied_note: Pause, move to an approved access position, and return through a checked route, while refusing generic retract behavior during incompatible operations.

features.title: Machine “black box” recorder
features.description_from_supplied_note: Preserve the commands, feedback, alarms, and state transitions immediately before and after a fault, including events too brief to notice on-screen.

features.title: Plain-language fault diagnosis
features.description_from_supplied_note: Explain “clamp pressure dropped before spindle enable disappeared,” distinguish evidence from inference, and identify the next measurement instead of displaying only an alarm number.

features.title: Transactional updates and rollback
features.description_from_supplied_note: Update firmware, gateware, and configuration as a compatible set; retain a known-good version and prohibit updates while the machine is armed.

features.title: ESP32 rescue interface
features.description_from_supplied_note: Keep a separate diagnostic path available when the main Linux system fails, with fault history and controlled recovery—not unverified mid-cut motion takeover.

features.title: Load-aware adaptive feed
features.description_from_supplied_note: Adjust feed within approved limits using spindle-load or cutting-force feedback, while distinguishing normal engagement changes from overload conditions.

features.title: Chatter detection and bounded response
features.description_from_supplied_note: Analyze vibration and propose or apply validated spindle-speed/feed adjustments, rather than simply slowing every noisy cut.

features.title: Commanded-versus-actual position dashboard
features.description_from_supplied_note: Compare commanded position, motor-encoder position, and linear-scale position where available, helping expose lost motion downstream of the motor.

features.title: Actual feed per spindle revolution
features.description_from_supplied_note: Maintain the selected feed per revolution using measured spindle motion instead of assuming the spindle always reaches its commanded speed.

features.title: Encoder-synchronized threading
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate the cutting axis to spindle angle through speed variation, with setup tests for encoder direction, index, scaling, and synchronization.

features.title: Rigid tapping with verified reversal
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate spindle reversal and axial withdrawal, with explicit checks for the drive’s capabilities and synchronization errors.

features.title: Constant-surface-speed turning
features.description_from_supplied_note: Adjust spindle speed as cutting diameter changes, with clear maximum-RPM limits and a preview of the expected speed range.

features.title: Existing-thread pickup
features.description_from_supplied_note: Help locate the phase and pitch of an existing thread so it can be chased or extended without manually guessing alignment.

features.title: Spindle-to-C-axis transitions
features.description_from_supplied_note: Switch a supported spindle between rotation and position control through a verified sequence that prevents conflicting commands or incorrect clamp states.

features.title: Five-axis tool-center-point control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Maintain the programmed tool-tip position while rotary axes move, using calibrated geometry, tool length, and validated machine kinematics.

features.title: ATC teaching wizard
features.description_from_supplied_note: Teach rack or carousel locations visually, then test each movement and sensor transition individually before allowing a complete automatic tool change.

features.title: Tool-seated verification
features.description_from_supplied_note: Confirm the expected drawbar, tool-present, and changer states; identify the exact failed condition instead of reporting a generic tool-change alarm.

features.title: Automatic tool-break checks
features.description_from_supplied_note: Compare tool measurements before and after critical operations, or use a suitable break detector, to stop subsequent operations from machining with a missing cutter.

features.title: Sister-tool substitution
features.description_from_supplied_note: Replace an expired or failed tool with an approved equivalent, revalidate its offsets, and identify which operations can resume with it.

features.title: Workholding verification
features.description_from_supplied_note: Monitor vacuum, pneumatic, or hydraulic holding conditions against process-specific limits and inhibit the next operation when holding conditions are inadequate.

features.title: Fixture identity and setup recall
features.description_from_supplied_note: Identify a fixture, load its tools and setup recipe, then verify its physical registration before accepting the saved work offsets.

features.title: Interchangeable-head recognition
features.description_from_supplied_note: Identify a spindle, laser, extruder, or dispenser and load its offsets and permitted outputs, with process changes allowed only while disarmed.

features.title: Position-synchronized auxiliary outputs
features.description_from_supplied_note: Trigger dispensing, marking, cameras, or valves at defined path positions rather than depending on a user-interface timer.

features.title: Discoverable expansion devices
features.description_from_supplied_note: Recognize supported modules, show their capabilities and firmware compatibility, and bind their signals without hand-editing low-level configuration.

features.title: Registered print–probe–mill workflows
features.description_from_supplied_note: Print a part, measure it, and machine selected surfaces within a coordinated setup, with process-specific clearances and tool changes.

features.title: Guided pressure-advance calibration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Generate a test, help evaluate the result, and save the setting against the actual nozzle, material, temperature, and extrusion configuration.

features.title: Automatic resonance characterization
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure vibration, propose input-shaping settings, and show the associated acceleration and smoothing tradeoffs for each toolhead configuration.

features.title: Temperature-aware adaptive bed mapping
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure only the required print area while tracking whether bed temperature or machine changes make the previous mesh unreliable.

features.title: Actual-nozzle Z referencing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Establish nozzle height through a suitable contact system, incorporating nozzle cleaning and repeatability checks instead of trusting a fixed probe offset forever.

features.title: Measured filament delivery
features.description_from_supplied_note: Compare requested extrusion with actual filament movement, report persistent discrepancies, and pause when the delivery system is no longer following commands.

features.title: Jam-source diagnosis
features.description_from_supplied_note: Combine filament motion, spool tension, and available drive data to distinguish likely tangles, slipping, and nozzle restrictions, while reporting diagnostic uncertainty.

features.title: Calibrated volumetric-flow limits
features.description_from_supplied_note: Characterize a material/hotend combination and flag or constrain toolpaths that demand more melt flow than the validated setup can provide.

features.title: Verified heater fault handling
features.description_from_supplied_note: Detect implausible temperatures, inadequate heating, and heating while commanded off; use an independent cutoff path where required to interrupt failed power switching.

features.title: First-layer inspection
features.description_from_supplied_note: Check deposited lines for missing regions, gross gaps, or excessive buildup and pause for review; allow correction only within a validated adjustment envelope.

features.title: Selective failed-object cancellation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Cancel one object in a multi-part print while preserving the others, then reevaluate travel paths around the failed material.

features.title: Automatic multi-tool offset calibration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure the relative nozzle positions and verify alignment with a test pattern, rather than relying on repeated manual tuning prints.

features.title: Measured purge completion
features.description_from_supplied_note: Reduce unnecessary color-change purging by monitoring the extrudate against a validated transition criterion, with conservative fallback behavior.

features.title: Independent-carriage collision management
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate multiple moving printheads using their actual envelopes, parked positions, and remaining printed geometry.

features.title: Verified spool-change continuation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Switch to an approved replacement material, confirm filament delivery, restore extrusion conditions, and resume from a controlled checkpoint.

features.title: Chamber thermal-stability management
features.description_from_supplied_note: Start temperature-sensitive operations only after the chamber meets defined stability criteria, then coordinate cooling rather than abruptly ending heat control.

features.title: Zoned-bed temperature control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Heat only needed regions while monitoring boundary temperatures and avoiding uneven thermal conditions across the part.

features.title: Force-aware resin peeling
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure separation loads and adapt supported lift profiles within validated limits, while recognizing abnormal sticking or release behavior.

features.title: Resin exposure-uniformity calibration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use suitable optical measurements to generate supported exposure corrections, while synchronizing the exposure engine and motion system.

features.title: Nonplanar printing support
features.description_from_supplied_note: Execute supported curved-layer paths with nozzle-body collision checks and suitable extrusion control, rather than treating every layer as a horizontal plane.

features.title: Verified batch changeover
features.description_from_supplied_note: Permit the next print only after the supported removal mechanism completes and bed clearance is confirmed; otherwise stop for operator intervention.

features.title: Height-corrected camera placement
features.description_from_supplied_note: Calibrate camera distortion and material height so artwork placement remains meaningful when switching between thin sheet and thicker objects.

features.title: Fiducial-based print-and-cut registration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Locate reference marks, report registration error, and apply only the approved translation, rotation, or scaling needed for that job.

features.title: Surface-following focus
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure a supported surface and adjust focus through the job within the optical system’s validated range.

features.title: Calibrated energy-per-distance control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Account for actual motion speed and a measured power-response curve when commanding the laser, rather than assuming every power percentage is proportional.

features.title: Bidirectional engraving calibration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Generate and evaluate alignment patterns to compensate direction-dependent scan offsets at different engraving speeds.

features.title: Dedicated raster execution
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate pixel timing, motion, and overscan so engraving is not reduced to a huge stream of poorly timed individual G-code movements.

features.title: Measured kerf and fit calibration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Generate test coupons, record measured results, and apply material/process-specific fit compensation for press-fit and slip-fit parts.

features.title: Tapered-object rotary engraving
features.description_from_supplied_note: Map artwork onto a supported tapered shape while accounting for changing circumference and focus, instead of treating every object as a cylinder.

features.title: Cut-through verification
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use a suitable sensing method to assess whether a supported material was fully cut and identify where another pass is justified.

features.title: Verified laser operating conditions
features.description_from_supplied_note: Require the relevant enclosure, cooling, and extraction conditions before beam enable, with independent hardware inhibition where needed—not just on-screen warnings.

features.title: Ohmic/float sensing diagnostics
features.description_from_supplied_note: Test material sensing, detect stuck or inconsistent signals, and explain when the machine is using the verified fallback method.

features.title: Context-aware torch-height control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Combine arc feedback with actual speed and path conditions so corner slowdowns and existing gaps do not provoke inappropriate height corrections.

features.title: Guided failed-pierce recovery
features.description_from_supplied_note: Identify the failed pierce, inspect the conditions, and prepare a bounded retry or alternate lead-in rather than restarting the entire sheet blindly.

features.title: Breakaway-torch recovery
features.description_from_supplied_note: Stop on a breakaway event, guide mechanical reseating, reverify torch registration, and prepare a checked return to the interrupted cut.

features.title: Small-hole process control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Apply validated hole-specific speed, height-control, and supported power-source settings, with the resulting changes visible in the job preview.

features.title: Heat-aware cutting sequence
features.description_from_supplied_note: Distribute cuts to reduce concentrated heating and avoid prematurely releasing unstable pieces, while respecting tabs, clamps, and required operation order.

features.title: Consumable-condition tracking
features.description_from_supplied_note: Combine pierce history, operating data, and observed cut quality to recommend inspection or replacement rather than relying only on an hour counter.

features.title: Built-in real-time qualification
features.description_from_supplied_note: Test controller timing under representative graphics and I/O loads, record the margin, and flag configuration changes that invalidate the previous qualification.

features.title: Evidence-based local diagnostic assistant
features.description_from_supplied_note: Answer questions using the installed machine configuration, manuals, and logs; propose reviewed actions rather than directly issuing unverified machine commands.

features.title: Complete portable machine backup
features.description_from_supplied_note: Export a reproducible package containing configuration, compatible software versions, wiring, tools, calibration, fixtures, and job data, with a guided restore-verification process.

features.title: Jerk-limited S-curve motion
features.description_from_supplied_note: Control how quickly acceleration changes, with separate profiles for cutting, rapid travel, and delicate positioning.

features.title: Handwheel-controlled program execution
features.description_from_supplied_note: Turn the handwheel to advance through a programmed toolpath; stop turning to request a controlled hold. LinuxCNC’s external adaptive-feed interface provides a foundation for this integration.

features.title: Electronic cam profiles
features.description_from_supplied_note: Make an axis follow a programmable displacement-versus-spindle-angle curve for cam grinding, eccentric features, or synchronized repetitive mechanisms.

features.title: Electronic gearing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Maintain a commanded angular ratio between separate rotating axes, with phase-error monitoring for applications such as gear hobbing.

features.title: Automatic rotary unwinding
features.description_from_supplied_note: Plan when and where a rotary axis can unwind without wrapping cables, striking fixtures, or changing the intended tool orientation.

features.title: True dual-loop position control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use motor feedback for the inner drive loop and a linear scale for an outer correction loop, with stability limits—not merely display both positions.

features.title: Guided servo-loop tuning
features.description_from_supplied_note: Perform bounded identification moves, evaluate following error and oscillation, and propose gains and filters with a reversible comparison test.

features.title: Constant-force machining
features.description_from_supplied_note: Maintain controlled contact force during sanding, polishing, deburring, or surface finishing instead of relying entirely on fixed Z positions.

features.title: Tolerance-bounded toolpath smoothing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Replace suitable chains of tiny segments with smoother trajectories while showing the maximum permitted contour deviation. Look-ahead and smoothing are established methods for managing this tradeoff.

features.title: Payload-aware acceleration limits
features.description_from_supplied_note: Select a tested motion envelope based on the installed toolhead, fixture, or moving-bed load instead of using one acceleration setting for every configuration.

features.title: Main-spindle/subspindle part transfer
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate spindle speed, phase, approach, and verified clamping before transferring a part between chucks.

features.title: Live-tool polar interpolation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Convert supported XY-style contours into coordinated linear and C-axis motion for machining features on a lathe’s part face.

features.title: Coordinated tailstock and steady-rest control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Schedule support engagement around the toolpath, verify position and pressure, and prevent tool approaches through occupied support regions.

features.title: Intelligent bar-feeder cycles
features.description_from_supplied_note: Track remaining bar length, account for cutoff losses, verify feed movement, and refuse a new part when insufficient usable stock remains.

features.title: Spindle-locked broaching cycles
features.description_from_supplied_note: Generate incremental keyway or slot-broaching strokes with verified spindle orientation and a suitable locking mechanism. LinuxCNC already provides spindle-orientation interfaces to build around.

features.title: Oscillatory chip-breaking motion
features.description_from_supplied_note: Superimpose a validated feed-axis oscillation during supported turning operations to interrupt chip formation without manually programming every oscillation.

features.title: Automatic grinding-wheel dressing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Execute dressing routines, update the wheel’s effective geometry, and account for the resulting changes in machining position and permitted operating speed.

features.title: Coolant-aware deep-hole drilling
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate peck depth, full withdrawals, flushing intervals, and verified coolant delivery instead of relying on one fixed canned cycle.

features.title: Cutting-tool deflection compensation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use a calibrated tool/stickout/load model to propose bounded finishing-path corrections for tool bending, with the assumptions visible to the operator.

features.title: Condition-based spindle warmup
features.description_from_supplied_note: Run an approved warmup sequence and evaluate temperature, vibration, and idle history before declaring the spindle ready for precision work.

features.title: Interactive spindle-tramming assistant
features.description_from_supplied_note: Take indicator or probe measurements and show which mounting adjustment to make, in which direction, and by approximately how much.

features.title: Circular-interpolation diagnostic tests
features.description_from_supplied_note: Run controlled circles with a ballbar or other suitable measurement system and separate measured contour error from the commanded path.

features.title: Direction-dependent probe calibration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Characterize probe triggering from different approach directions and apply calibrated corrections rather than assuming identical behavior in every direction.

features.title: Tool-runout measurement
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure the rotating tool or holder, record runout against that assembly, and flag an unacceptable setup before a precision operation.

features.title: Three-plane squareness calibration
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure XY, XZ, and YZ skew separately and generate bounded geometry corrections. Klipper’s documented skew correction provides an existing example of this capability.

features.title: Best-fit setup for castings and rough blanks
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure an irregular blank and find a proposed part placement that leaves sufficient machining allowance on all critical surfaces.

features.title: Clamp-distortion measurement
features.description_from_supplied_note: Compare selected reference points before and after tightening the workholding to identify where the fixture is bending the part.

features.title: Measurement-confidence reporting
features.description_from_supplied_note: Attach repeatability and calibration uncertainty to inspection results, so a screen displaying four decimal places does not imply that accuracy.

features.title: Spindle-bearing health trending
features.description_from_supplied_note: Compare controlled no-cut vibration measurements over time and flag developing changes separately from cutting chatter.

features.title: Verified lubrication delivery
features.description_from_supplied_note: Confirm lubricant reaches monitored circuits, track consumption against axis travel, and identify failed delivery rather than merely counting pump commands.

features.title: Voltage readings at field terminals
features.description_from_supplied_note: Show the measured voltage at supported input and supply terminals, helping distinguish “the switch is off” from “the sensor has no power.”

features.title: Individually protected output branches
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure load current, detect overloads, isolate the affected branch, and identify the connected device while initiating the configured machine fault response.

features.title: Broken-wire and short-circuit detection
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use supported supervised input circuits to distinguish a legitimate switch state from an open cable or shorted pair.

features.title: Configurable PNP/NPN sensor inputs
features.description_from_supplied_note: Support documented sourcing and sinking sensor configurations through rated interface hardware, with changes restricted to a disarmed setup state.

features.title: Plug-in wiring-harness tester
features.description_from_supplied_note: Test disconnected harnesses for swapped pins, shorts, continuity, and intermittent connections before attaching expensive drives or sensors.

features.title: EtherCAT servo integration module
features.description_from_supplied_note: Add a supported digital-drive backend with explicit drive profiles, feedback mapping, timing qualification, and fault handling—not an unexplained Ethernet socket.

features.title: Absolute-encoder interface modules
features.description_from_supplied_note: Support defined protocols such as SSI or BiSS-C, including encoder status checks and a verified procedure for establishing machine position.

features.title: Replaceable field-I/O protection cartridges
features.description_from_supplied_note: Put vulnerable interface and protection components on serviceable modules so one damaged field connection does not require replacing the entire controller.

features.title: Electrical-noise correlation tests
features.description_from_supplied_note: During controlled testing, correlate unexpected input transitions or communication errors with VFD starts, contactor switching, and other electrical events.

features.title: Vertical-axis brake verification
features.description_from_supplied_note: Test the holding and release sequence under controlled conditions and detect disagreement between brake commands and available feedback. Keep required safety functions in appropriate hardware.

features.title: Teach-and-repeat programming
features.description_from_supplied_note: Jog through a sequence, capture meaningful points and actions, then edit and preview the generated program before allowing automatic execution.

features.title: Virtual stops for manual machining
features.description_from_supplied_note: Set temporary approach limits and endpoints for manual facing, drilling, or positioning without rewriting the machine’s permanent travel limits.

features.title: Augmented camera setup view
features.description_from_supplied_note: Overlay work-coordinate axes, fixture outlines, and selected toolpath features on a calibrated live camera image, with registration uncertainty visible.

features.title: Dedicated manual-DRO mode
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use installed scales as a digital readout while motion outputs remain positively disabled, allowing the same system to support manual machine operation.

features.title: Visual program-revision comparison
features.description_from_supplied_note: Highlight changed toolpaths, depths, feeds, tools, and offsets between an approved program and a replacement file before loading it.

features.title: G-code macro debugger
features.description_from_supplied_note: Step through macros in simulation, inspect variables and branches, set breakpoints, and identify the exact condition causing an unexpected move.

features.title: Transactional work-offset editing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Preview and approve a group of offset changes together, preserve the previous set, and allow reversal while halted without confusing that with reversing physical motion.

features.title: Common-tool batching across fixtures
features.description_from_supplied_note: Group proven-independent operations by tool across multiple workpieces while preserving each part’s required operation order.

features.title: Oversized-tool magazine management
features.description_from_supplied_note: Reserve adjacent pockets around large cutters and check the permitted tool arrangements before a carousel or rack movement.

features.title: Resource-controlled local graphics
features.description_from_supplied_note: Limit memory and CPU consumption by CAD import, previews, and optional applications; defer heavy work rather than letting it consume unrestricted controller resources.

features.title: Actual nozzle-pressure feedback
features.description_from_supplied_note: Regulate extrusion using measured melt pressure rather than relying exclusively on a predictive pressure-advance model.

features.title: Continuous material-ratio blending
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate multiple material feeds to produce calibrated composition or color gradients within a toolpath, including transport-delay compensation.

features.title: Pellet-extruder control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate auger speed, melt-zone temperatures, pressure, and measured delivery for supported pellet-fed printheads.

features.title: Continuous-fiber placement
features.description_from_supplied_note: Synchronize fiber feeding, cutting, and consolidation with the print path, including allowable bend radii and termination locations.

features.title: Embedded-insert workflow
features.description_from_supplied_note: Pause at planned cavities, guide insertion of nuts, magnets, or electronics, verify placement, and check nozzle clearance before continuing.

features.title: Directional material-shrinkage compensation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Apply a calibrated material/process model to the prepared geometry, distinguishing directional shrinkage from machine squareness or positioning errors.

features.title: Layer-by-layer dimensional inspection
features.description_from_supplied_note: Scan the growing part and compare its geometry with the expected layer, then flag accumulated height or shape errors before completion.

features.title: Active anti-ooze nozzle control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate a supported shutoff valve or needle mechanism with extrusion and travel, including verified opening delays and pressure release.

features.title: Toolpath-aware part cooling
features.description_from_supplied_note: Adjust cooling and minimum revisit time based on the local feature and deposition schedule rather than using one fan percentage for an entire layer.

features.title: Filament-diameter and ovality compensation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Measure filament cross-section upstream and correct the corresponding extrusion volume after accounting for travel delay to the nozzle.

features.title: Transactional variable-data marking
features.description_from_supplied_note: Generate names, dates, serial numbers, or CSV-driven text, then record each item as pending, completed, or uncertain. Variable-data generation is established; reliable completion accounting would be your addition.

features.title: Read-back verification of markings
features.description_from_supplied_note: Scan the finished barcode, QR code, or supported text and compare its contents against what the job requested.

features.title: Coordinated galvo-and-gantry processing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Combine fast local mirror motion with a larger mechanical stage, maintaining a shared coordinate system through field transitions.

features.title: Guided galvo-lens correction
features.description_from_supplied_note: Mark and measure a calibration pattern, calculate distortion corrections, and save them against the installed lens. LightBurn documents this general calibration workflow.

features.title: Source-specific pulse control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Expose supported pulse duration, repetition frequency, and power combinations for compatible laser sources, rejecting combinations outside the source’s documented operating envelope.

features.title: Calibrated depth engraving
features.description_from_supplied_note: Convert a relief model into removal passes using a measured material/process response, instead of assuming grayscale value directly equals engraving depth.

features.title: Conveyor “marking on the fly”
features.description_from_supplied_note: Track a conveyor encoder and continually transform marking coordinates so supported parts can be marked while moving.

features.title: Color-marking recipe development
features.description_from_supplied_note: Generate controlled test matrices and record measured results under consistent lighting to help reproduce color effects on suitable materials.

features.title: Oversized-sheet tiling
features.description_from_supplied_note: Divide a design into reachable sections and guide material repositioning, including overlap checks and explicit registration error at each seam.

features.title: Markerless batch placement
features.description_from_supplied_note: Locate recognizable blanks scattered across a tray, propose their poses, and place the approved artwork on each without dedicated fiducial marks.

features.title: Tangential-knife control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Rotate a knife to follow the cutting direction, compensate its geometry, and lift or swivel at corners according to the material.

features.title: Oscillating-knife process control
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate reciprocation, feed, and corner behavior for supported foam, gasket, or corrugated-material cutting heads.

features.title: Four-axis hot-wire cutting
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate both ends of a heated wire for tapered shapes, including calibrated kerf, wire-lag, and sag compensation.

features.title: EDM gap-control mode
features.description_from_supplied_note: Adjust feed and withdrawal from isolated discharge feedback while a dedicated power unit handles pulse generation.

features.title: Two-component dispensing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Maintain the required resin/hardener delivery ratio, monitor dispensing conditions, and track mixer dwell time and approved purge procedures.

features.title: Pick-and-place operation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Import component placement data, coordinate feeders and vacuum pickup, and use vision to correct supported component alignment.

features.title: Verified adhesive or solder-paste deposition
features.description_from_supplied_note: Inspect deposited dots or beads and compare their position and size against the required pattern before proceeding.

features.title: Welding-seam tracking
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use a suitable sensor to adjust the programmed weld path within a qualified welding-cell configuration, with bounded correction and lost-seam handling.

features.title: Plasma bevel preparation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Generate supported tilted-torch paths with angle-dependent offsets and process settings for weld-preparation edges.

features.title: Waterjet taper and trail compensation
features.description_from_supplied_note: Coordinate supported head tilt and feed using a calibrated cutting model, with pressure and abrasive delivery handled by dedicated equipment.

features.title: Shared-compressor coordination
features.description_from_supplied_note: Request the pressure and airflow needed for the next operation, delay starting until available, and coordinate competing machine demands through a defined shop interface.

features.title: Automatic dust-extraction zoning
features.description_from_supplied_note: Open the appropriate blast gates for the active machine or tool, verify the requested airflow, and close unused branches.

features.title: Coolant-mixture monitoring
features.description_from_supplied_note: Record concentration, temperature, and tank level, then guide or control an approved replenishment process rather than adding water by guesswork.

features.title: Automatically aimed coolant nozzles
features.description_from_supplied_note: Position motorized nozzles according to the selected tool and cutting location, with teachable aim points and collision limits.

features.title: Chip-conveyor jam management
features.description_from_supplied_note: Detect abnormal conveyor load, perform only an approved bounded recovery sequence, and stop before repeated retries damage the mechanism.

features.title: Geometry-aware vacuum zoning
features.description_from_supplied_note: Select workholding zones based on stock placement and the cutting sequence, maintaining verified holding conditions as pieces become separated.

features.title: Shop electrical-load scheduling
features.description_from_supplied_note: Stagger approved heater, compressor, and spindle startup requests within a configured power budget, without unexpectedly interrupting an active process.

features.title: Part genealogy
features.description_from_supplied_note: Link each finished part to its material lot, job revision, machine configuration, tools, calibration state, and recorded inspection results.

features.title: Actual cost-per-good-part reporting
features.description_from_supplied_note: Combine measured cycle time, energy, material use, tool consumption, and scrap using user-entered cost rates rather than reporting only machine hours.

features.title: Cross-machine operation tracking
features.description_from_supplied_note: Carry a part’s production record from printing to milling to engraving, preventing an unfinished or incorrectly revised part from silently advancing to the next operation.

features.title: Sandboxed extensions
features.description_from_supplied_note: Give plugins explicit permissions and resource limits; deny direct access to motion outputs unless commands pass through the controller’s authorized interface.

features.title: Signed production jobs
features.description_from_supplied_note: Verify who approved a job and whether its toolpaths, settings, or setup requirements changed afterward, without requiring a cloud account.

features.title: Local operator permissions
features.description_from_supplied_note: Separate setup, operation, maintenance, and development privileges so an operator can run approved work without accidentally changing machine geometry.

features.title: Consent-based remote support
features.description_from_supplied_note: Start remote sessions read-only, make access visible and time-limited, and require local authorization for permitted control actions.

features.title: Controlled configuration experiments
features.description_from_supplied_note: Compare candidate settings through the same bounded test, retain the measured results, and activate a selected configuration only while disarmed.

features.title: Visual HAL signal editor
features.description_from_supplied_note: Connect supported control components graphically, display signal types and execution relationships, and flag incompatible connections or problematic dependency loops.

features.title: Automated hardware regression testing
features.description_from_supplied_note: Use a test fixture to verify supported inputs, outputs, encoder channels, pulse timing, and fault behavior after hardware or firmware changes.

features.title: Offline fault replay
features.description_from_supplied_note: Feed recorded input events into a simulation to investigate a failure and test a proposed fix without energizing the real machine.

features.title: Expansion-module development kit
features.description_from_supplied_note: Publish interface definitions, example drivers, virtual devices, and conformance tests so third parties can build compatible accessories without reverse-engineering the board.

features.title: Capability-based job exchange
features.description_from_supplied_note: Attach explicit machine requirements to a portable job package, explain incompatibilities before transfer, and require validated conversion rather than blindly replaying another machine’s G-code.
